listing.name: Stargate Unknown Galaxies
listing.summary: Adds Tauri, Lantean, and Goauld ships with custom weapons and market/faction implementations to Starsector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds Tauri, Lantean, and Goauld ships with custom weapons and market/faction implementations to Starsector.

description:
Stargate Unknown Galaxies a Starsector Mod

Download

I allways was a huge stargate fan, imagine my disappointment nobody made a decent starsector mod for it, thats why i thought why not make it yourself, i need to admit i am a complete novice on modding new content but nevertheless i hope you enjoy this small mod.

This is a early release for balance and feedback purposes, it also is my first real modding project.

If you want to check out some gameplay i post status updates with images/videos on the starsector reddit.

Whats implemented so far?

Currently there are:

- 9 Tauri Ships

- 4 Lantean Ships

- 1 Goauld Ship

Custom Weapons for all fully implemented Ships

From the famous Lantean drones to Asgard beams and nukes there is lots of variity allthough its not very well balanced.

Market implementation

Most ships will spawn in Markets but i recommend the

Console Command Mod

for now.

Lantean Ships should spawn as derelicts as they are far to Powerfull if you could buy or make them.

Faction implementation

The Tauri Faction is somewhat functional but they dont have a spawn, you could use console commands to give them a fleet ingame.

Blueprints

Blueprints for the Tauri do exist and you should be able to find/buy them.

Disclaimer:

I dont claim ownership of these sprites if there are any issues feel free to message me.

My Thanks to dolynick and mallacore for allowing me to use there sprites.

Here a link to his work:

Dolynick - Deviantart

Here a link to his work:

Mallacore - Deviantart

Also i wish to extend my thanks to Harmful Mechanic i used his Blueprint templates for this mod also i enjoy his other mods alot. :)

Harmful Mechanics Miscellaneous Starsector Assets

[/list]
